title: The Marine at the door
text: A Marine officer knocks, asking where {legacy.parentName} has gone. The wanted poster in their hand has your family's name on it.

choices.label: Tell the truth
choices.text: You do not know, and you say so.

effects.text: The officer believes you, which somehow makes it worse.

choices.label: Send them the wrong way
choices.text: A false lead, given with a straight face.

effects.text: You send the Marines toward the wrong island and do not sleep that night.
You shut the door in the officer's face. They write something down.
